correctness.rationale: The 3-round exact recursion records all atomic equalities and 64 multiplication instances on named zero and up to three variables. A fully exhaustive C++ pass for every n=1..26 gives nine classes, and an independent immutable-set Python implementation reproduces n=1..12. A proved paired-index order game with t_0=0 and t_(r+1)=3t_r+2 establishes equivalence for all n,m>=26; transitivity joins U_9 to that tail. The distinct exact root types prove the sharp boundary; no extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: The positive-length path semigroup with zero of a finite oriented line is a standard nilpotent, noncommutative family: nilpotency index increases with n, but rank-three first-order relational logic collapses precisely at nine indices. The claim determines a complete natural invariant and sharp 37-element representative bound; the exact threshold cannot be inferred from generic order-game stabilization (only n>=26). The family and depth are mathematically motivated, not an arbitrary finite slice.
